#ifndef PRIVATE_FRAME_PHASE_PROFILE_H
#define PRIVATE_FRAME_PHASE_PROFILE_H

#include <stdint.h>

enum private_frame_phase {
    PRIVATE_PHASE_RETIRE,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_LIGHT,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_DISPLAY_UPDATE,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_WORLD_DRAW,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_HUD,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_WORLD_PICK,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_WORLD_CAMERA,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_WORLD_CULL,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_WORLD_CHUNK_UPDATE,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_WORLD_SUBMIT,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_WORLD_ENTITIES,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_WORLD,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_PROVIDER,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_TEXTURE,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_CONTROLLER,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_PICK,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_ALL,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_DK_COMPILE,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_ENTITIES,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_SCHEDULER,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_TICK_RANDOM_DISPLAY,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_SCHEDULER_SPAWNING,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_SCHEDULER_PROVIDER,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_SCHEDULER_SAVE,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_SCHEDULER_SCHEDULED,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_SCHEDULER_RANDOM,
    PRIVATE_PHASE_COUNT
};

enum private_frame_note {
    PRIVATE_NOTE_UPDATE_INITIAL_QUEUE,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_UPDATE_NEAR,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_UPDATE_ATTEMPTS,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_UPDATE_COMPLETED,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_UPDATE_REMAINING,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_COMPILE_DIRTY,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_COMPILE_RETURNED,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_RANDOM_CHUNKS,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_RANDOM_SAMPLES,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_AMBIENCE_SAMPLES,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SPAWN_CHUNKS,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SPAWN_CANDIDATES,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SPAWN_RANDOM_CALLS,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SPAWN_CONSTRUCTORS,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SPAWN_PREDICATES,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SPAWN_PUBLICATIONS,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SCHEDULED_INITIAL,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SCHEDULED_ITERATIONS,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_SCHEDULED_REMOVED,
    PRIVATE_NOTE_COUNT
};

typedef struct private_frame_phase_row {
    uint64_t notes[PRIVATE_NOTE_COUNT];
    int64_t ticks[PRIVATE_PHASE_COUNT];
    uint32_t calls[PRIVATE_PHASE_COUNT], valid[PRIVATE_PHASE_COUNT];
    uint32_t flags;
} private_frame_phase_row;

/* Fixed video-thread hooks. A NULL current row performs no clock query. */
void private_frame_phase_begin(unsigned int phase);
void private_frame_phase_end(unsigned int phase);
void private_frame_phase_note(unsigned int note, uint64_t value);

#endif
